sloka: आरूढो मेघसङ्काशं वारणेन्द्रं महोदरः।वालिपुत्रं महावीर्यमभिदुद्राव वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७०.२ ।।
transliteration: ārūḍho meghasaṅkāśaṁ vāraṇendraṁ mahodaraḥ।vāliputraṁ mahāvīryamabhidudrāva vīryavān ।। 6.70.2 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara who closely resembled a cloud, mounted on the best of elephants chased brave and courageous son of Vali.
